---

<!--
================================================================================
  Figure Panel  : Supp S2B
  Description   : CONSORT-style flowchart of TCGA COAD/READ sample selection
                  (594 clinical samples -> 216 MSS RAS-mutant / 226 MSS RAS-wildtype).
  Input data    : none (sample counts are written into the script)
  Output        : Flowchart_TCGA_RAS_mutant_wildtype.png
                  Flowchart_TCGA_RAS_mutant_wildtype.pdf
  R packages    : DiagrammeR, DiagrammeRsvg, rsvg
  Authors       : Sadanandam Lab, Institute of Cancer Research, London
  Contact       : anguraj.sadanandam@icr.ac.uk
  Note          : Counts are taken from the cohort-definition notebook (Fig1A_B_C).
================================================================================
-->

```{r}
# ---- Flowchart of sample counts (TCGA COAD/READ) ----
# Counts used:
# - Clinical samples = 594  # from clinical glimpse rows 
# - Aligned clinical + mutation samples = 528  # alignment sanity check 
# - MSS samples = 468; MSI samples = 60  # MSIsensor cutoff 20 
# - MSS (regular mutation load) = 442  # TMB < 10 filter within MSS 
# - RAS-mutant MSS = 216; RAS-WT MSS = 226  # KRAS/NRAS split within MSS regular-load 

# install.packages(c("DiagrammeR", "DiagrammeRsvg", "rsvg"), dependencies = TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DiagrammeR)
  library(DiagrammeRsvg)
  library(rsvg)
})

# ---- Parameters (edit counts here if needed) ----
counts <- list(
  clinical            = 594,
  aligned             = 528,
  mss                 = 468,
  msi                 = 60,
  mss_reg_load        = 442,
  ras_mutant_mss      = 216,
  ras_wt_mss          = 226
)

# ---- Build Graphviz DOT ----
dot <- sprintf('
digraph G {
  graph [rankdir=TB, nodesep=0.35, ranksep=0.5]
  node  [shape=box, style="rounded,filled", fillcolor="#cfe8ff", fontname="Helvetica", penwidth=1.2]
  edge  [penwidth=1.1]

  clinical   [label="Clinical samples\\n(n=%d)"];
  aligned    [label="Aligned clinical + mutation samples\\n(n=%d)"];
  mss        [label="MSS samples\\n(n=%d)"];
  msi        [label="MSI samples\\n(n=%d)"];
  mssrl      [label="MSS (regular mutation load)\\n(n=%d)"];
  rasmut     [label="RAS-mutant MSS\\n(n=%d)"];
  raswt      [label="RAS-WT MSS\\n(n=%d)"];

  clinical -> aligned;
  aligned  -> mss;
  aligned  -> msi;
  mss      -> mssrl;
  mssrl    -> rasmut;
  mssrl    -> raswt;

  {rank=same; mss; msi}
  {rank=same; rasmut; raswt}
}
',
  counts$clinical, counts$aligned, counts$mss, counts$msi,
  counts$mss_reg_load, counts$ras_mutant_mss, counts$ras_wt_mss
)

# ---- Render ----
g <- DiagrammeR::grViz(dot)

# Show in viewer (RStudio/Quarto)
g

# ---- Save to files ----
# PNG
png_file <- "Flowchart_TCGA_RAS_mutant_wildtype.png"
svg_txt  <- DiagrammeRsvg::export_svg(g)
rsvg::rsvg_png(charToRaw(svg_txt), file = png_file, width = 1600, height = 1200)

# PDF (optional)
pdf_file <- "Flowchart_TCGA_RAS_mutant_wildtype.pdf"
rsvg::rsvg_pdf(charToRaw(svg_txt), file = pdf_file, width = 1600, height = 1200)

message("Saved: ", normalizePath(png_file))
message("Saved: ", normalizePath(pdf_file))

```
